rule:
G(p) = Rn(psi) (p - pivot) + target, Rn = rotation by psi about the TABLE NORMAL n (maps the table plane onto itself, so every object's
   height and tilt relative to the table are exactly the source ones); pivot = mean dustpan xy over the 20 accepted DEV layouts (on its
   own height); target = pivot_target_xy with z on the same table-plane height. Applied to every object pose of every DEV layout
   (positions and orientations) -> the whole per-seed scene (cube/brush/dustpan relative poses and perturbations) is rigidly unchanged.
home: left (dustpan arm) = source canonical home TCP pose mapped by the same rigid group transform G as the objects (contact-home geometry relative to the dustpan preserved), solved by IK; right = generic declared ready pose (base (0.30,-0.22,0.12), approach down).
